Double $1 Every Day: When Do You Pass One Million?
description: Would you take one million dollars right now, or one dollar that doubles every single day? 💰
Take the dollar and you pass one million on day 20, and end day 30 with over one billion dollars!
The math (your total after d days = 2^d - 1):
The coin tower (a US dollar coin is 2 mm thick):

• Day 18: about 1 km, taller than the Burj Khalifa (828 m)
• Day 23: about 17 km, taller than Mount Everest
• Day 26: about 134 km, past the edge of space (100 km)
• Day 30: about 2,147 km, far above the ISS (408 km)
